bio.text: Gayle Harrell represents District 31 in the Florida Senate, to which Harrell was elected in 2018 and reelected subsequently.
Harrell served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2000 to 2008 and from 2010 to 2018, and is a health information technology consultant.
Harrell was born in Nashville, Tennessee, and moved to Florida in 1957. Harrell holds a B.A. in Spanish (1964) and an M.A. in Latin American studies and history (1977) from the University of Florida.
